theme_central: The longest Meccan surah: seven prophetic narratives (Musa, Ibrahim, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Lot, Shu'ayb) following the same pattern, sealed by the same refrain — "in that is a sign, and your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful".
sources_note: Precise and complete division sourced (medium.com/@soltlane, Deeper Exploration of Surah Ash-Shu'ara) — verse by verse for the seven narratives.

branches.title: Opening
branches.resume: The Prophet torments himself over their rejection; if He wished, a sign would make them yield, but the trial of free choice remains.

children.t: The Prophet's torment at their rejection, revelation comes from the Mighty, the Merciful

branches.title: Musa
branches.resume: Sent to Pharaoh despite his fear, the sorcerers' challenge, the exodus and crossing of the sea.

children.t: Musa sent to Pharaoh, dialogue, call to free the Children of Israel
The sorcerers' challenge, their instant conversion at the sight of the sign
Exodus, crossing of the sea, Pharaoh's drowning

branches.title: Ibrahim
branches.resume: Debate with his father and his people against idolatry, supplication for himself and for his father.

children.t: Ibrahim facing his father, arguments against the idols
Ibrahim's supplication, Paradise and Hell brought near on the Last Day

branches.title: Nuh
branches.resume: Call to his people, rejection, destruction by the flood.

children.t: Nuh's call, dialogue with his people, rejection, destruction

branches.title: Hud
branches.resume: Call to the people of 'Ad, rejection, destruction.

children.t: Hud's call to the people of 'Ad, rejection, destruction

branches.title: Salih
branches.resume: Call to the people of Thamud, the she-camel as a sign, rejection, destruction.

children.t: Salih's call, the sign of the she-camel, rejection, destruction

branches.title: Lot
branches.resume: Call to his people, rejection, destruction by a rain of stones.

children.t: Lot's call, rejection, destruction by a rain of stones

branches.title: Shu'ayb
branches.resume: Call to the people of the Wood, denunciation of fraud, rejection, destruction by the punishment of the day of the shadow.

children.t: Shu'ayb's call to the people of the Wood, rejection, destruction

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Revealed by the trustworthy Spirit in clear Arabic, refutation of the accusation of poetry, fate of the misguided poets.

children.t: Revealed by the trustworthy Spirit (Jibril) in clear Arabic, foretold in earlier scriptures
Warning not rushed, this is not the work of devils
Warning one's close relatives, relying on Allah the Mighty, the Merciful
Fate of the misguided poets, distinction of the believers who do good
